title: Feasibility of a Deep Learning-based Algorithm for Non-invasive Assessment of Vulnerable Coronary Plaque
official: Feasibility of a Deep Learning-based Algorithm for Non-invasive Assessment of Vulnerable Coronary Plaque
summary: The primary objective of this study is to assess the accuracy in terms of sensitivity, specificity, negative and positive predicted values of the DL-based algorithm with respect to correct identification of the plaque and associated vulnerability grade.

interventions.name: Deep Learning-based Vulnerable Plaque Detection and Assessment Tool

sites.f: Ospedale Di Voghera, Azienda Socio-Sanitaria Territoriale di Pavia
